dashboard.label: pfSense Host Investigator
dashboard.description: Investigate a specific host across pfSense filterlog events.

search.query: `pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest) | lookup pfsense_dns_hosts ip as src_ip_norm OUTPUT hostname as src_host_lookup | lookup pfsense_dns_hosts ip as dest_ip_norm OUTPUT hostname as dest_host_lookup | eval host_ip=src_ip_norm, host_label=coalesce(src_host, src_host_lookup, src_ip_norm) | append [ search `pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest) | lookup pfsense_dns_hosts ip as src_ip_norm OUTPUT hostname as src_host_lookup | lookup pfsense_dns_hosts ip as dest_ip_norm OUTPUT hostname as dest_host_lookup | eval host_ip=dest_ip_norm, host_label=coalesce(dest_host, dest_host_lookup, dest_ip_norm) ] | eval is_internal=if(cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", host_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", host_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", host_ip), 1, 0) | where is_internal=1 AND isnotnull(host_ip) AND host_ip!="" | stats count by host_ip host_label | sort - count | eval host_value=host_ip | append [| makeresults | eval host_value="*", host_label="All (RFC1918)"] | eval sort_key=if(host_value="*", "0", "1") | sort sort_key host_label | fields host_label host_value

`pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm) | eval host_tok=if("$host$"="", "*", "$host$") | where host_tok="*" OR src_ip_norm=host_tok OR dest_ip_norm=host_tok | stats count

`pfsense_index` sourcetype=pfsense:filterlog | eval rule_origin_norm=coalesce(rule_origin,"unknown") | eval rule_origin_tok=if("$rule_origin$"="" OR "$rule_origin$"="*", "*", "$rule_origin$") | where rule_origin_tok="*" OR rule_origin_norm=rule_origin_tok | eval action_norm=lower(coalesce(action,vendor_action)), direction_norm=lower(coalesce(direction,vendor_direction)), transport_norm=lower(coalesce(transport,vendor_transport)), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip,src), dest_ip_norm=coalesce(dest_ip,dest), dest_port_norm=coalesce(dest_port,dport), app_norm=lower(coalesce(app,application,app_proto)), bytes_norm=coalesce(bytes, bytes_in), src_host_norm=coalesce(src_host,""), dest_host_norm=coalesce(dest_host,""), src_display=coalesce(src_host, src_ip_norm), dest_display=coalesce(dest_host, dest_ip_norm) | eval host_tok=if("$host$"="", "*", "$host$") | where host_tok="*" OR src_ip_norm=host_tok OR dest_ip_norm=host_tok | eval peer=if(src_ip_norm=host_tok, dest_display, src_display) | stats dc(peer) as unique_peers
